label: lem:continuous_interval_integrable
title: Continuous functions are interval integrable
statement: If $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ is continuous on $[\min(a,b), \max(a,b)]$, then $f$ is interval integrable on $[a,b]$ with respect to the Lebesgue measure. This is \texttt{ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable}.
proof: Continuous functions on compact intervals are bounded and measurable, hence integrable.
